people.name: Carl Ritter
people.extract: Carl Ritter was a German geographer. Along with Alexander von Humboldt, he is considered one of the founders of modern geography, as they established it as an independent scientific discipline. From 1825 until his death, he occupied the first chair in geography at the University of Berlin.
highlights: Held first geography chair at University of Berlin.

people.name: Cirroc Lofton
people.extract: Cirroc Lofton is an American actor and podcaster who started his career at the age of nine with many minor roles. He got his start in the 1989 child education program Econ and Me, which teaches children economics. He is best known for playing Jake Sisko on the 1990s TV series Star Trek: Deep Space Nine.
highlights: Appeared in Star Trek: Deep Space Nine.

people.name: Ann Harding
people.extract: Ann Harding was an American theatre, motion picture, radio, and television actress. Harding was a regular on Broadway and on tour in the 1920s. In the 1930s, Harding was one of the first actresses to gain fame in the new medium of "talking pictures," and she was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Actress in 1931 for her work in Holiday.
highlights: American theatre and motion picture actress.
Oscar nominee for Best Actress in 1931 for Holiday.
